datasets.title: Oxford Spires — Keble College, sequence 02
datasets.description: Sequence 2024-03-12-keble-college-02 of the Oxford Spires dataset (Hesai QT64 lidar at 10 Hz and Alphasense IMU on a handheld rig, 300 s, 294 m outdoors). Trajectories are evaluated against the official ground truth (gt-tum.txt, ICP-registered to a Leica TLS map, in the lidar frame); maps against that TLS map.

runs.label: Canonical bag, clean full run (steps 1–8)
runs.source: start_benchmark.sh on branch Oxford-Spires (commit dc5c913), plus hdmapping-lio from commit 9877367 (steps 3, 7, 8 for it alone, then steps 4–6 for all)
runs.notes: Full start_benchmark.sh run from an empty ~/hdmapping-benchmark/data. 40 of 41 algorithms produced a session; loam-livox has no canonical config. steps 4–6 were then rerun for all algorithms and the step 7/8 summaries were merged. Step 8 ran with 1 job and a 900 s limit per map: 7 maps hit it and have no map metrics (i2ekf-lo, voxel-map, floam, kiss-icp, genz-icp, d-lio, resple). rko-lio stopped after 7 s of the 301 s walk (67 poses), so its APE covers only that start and its map is incomplete (Chamfer 10.5 m); resple covered the whole walk but drifted (APE RMSE 1.9 m). dlo, sr-lio and lio-ekf have very sparse maps (recall < 0.05). hdmapping-lio-opt-params is hdmapping-lio rerun on 2026-11-03 on this sequence with the tuned parameter file params/hdmapping-lio-opt-params/HDMapping_params_0.106.0_2026-11-01_15-35.toml (hdmapping-lio itself used default parameters). It ran on the same hdmapping-lio_standalone image (HDMapping 0.105.0, commit f721635), not on 0.106.0; output file names say 0.106.0 only because they take the version from the parameter file. Step 4-8 ran for it alone in a separate workspace with the same settings as this run (bucket 0.05 m, voxel 0.05 m, threshold 0.05 m, 900 s limit, 1 job).

trajectories.aligned: SE(3) Umeyama on positions, timestamps matched within 10 ms (as evo_traj -a)

datasets.title: Oxford Spires — Bodleian Library, sequence 02
datasets.description: Sequence 2024-05-20-bodleian-library-02 of the Oxford Spires dataset (Hesai QT64 lidar at 10 Hz and Alphasense IMU on a handheld rig, 499 s, 689 m outdoors). Trajectories are evaluated against the official ground truth (gt-tum.txt, ICP-registered to a Leica TLS map, in the lidar frame); maps against that TLS map (published as merged-cloud-1cm.e57 for this site).

runs.label: Canonical bag, clean full run (steps 1–8)
runs.source: start_benchmark.sh on branch Oxford-Spires (commit 9877367 + uncommitted .e57 TLS map support in step 1)
runs.notes: Full start_benchmark.sh run from an empty ~/hdmapping-benchmark/data. 39 of 41 algorithms produced a session: loam-livox has no canonical config, and lio-ekf's listener (bag -> session converter) died with std::bad_alloc on its 19.7 GB recorded bag, so lio-ekf has no results. The site's TLS map exists only as merged-cloud-1cm.e57; step 1 read it with pye57 (137.5 M of 190.8 M points kept within 20 m of the walk). Step 8 ran with 1 job and a 900 s limit per map: 6 maps hit it and have no map metrics (i2ekf-lo, voxel-map, floam, kiss-icp, genz-icp, d-lio). Map F-scores at 5 cm are low for every method (best 0.22, precision <= 0.33), well below keble-college-02; glim has the best APE (0.057 m) but a Chamfer of 8.3 m because its map misses much of the reference (TLS->map 16.4 m). D-LIO diverged (APE 6088 m). hdmapping-lio-opt-params is hdmapping-lio rerun on 2026-11-03 on this sequence with the tuned parameter file params/hdmapping-lio-opt-params/HDMapping_params_0.106.0_2026-11-01_15-35.toml (hdmapping-lio itself used default parameters). It ran on the same hdmapping-lio_standalone image (HDMapping 0.105.0, commit f721635), not on 0.106.0; output file names say 0.106.0 only because they take the version from the parameter file. Step 4-8 ran for it alone in a separate workspace with the same settings as this run (bucket 0.05 m, voxel 0.05 m, threshold 0.05 m, 900 s limit, 1 job).

datasets.title: HDMAPPING-CAVE-DATASET-1 — exp1
datasets.description: Experiment 1 of HDMAPPING-CAVE-DATASET-1 (Meziad cave, Livox MID360 + IMU, about 55 minutes). Trajectories are evaluated against the HDMapping ground-truth session; registered point clouds are evaluated against a FARO Focus TLS scan.

runs.label: Full pipeline run (steps 1–9), bag from Mandeye raw
runs.source: start_benchmark.sh from the HDMAPPING-CAVE-DATASET-1 orchestration branch (commit 6cb3ceb), algorithms on their Bunker-DVI-Dataset-reg-1 branches; exp1 raw data converted with mandeye_to_rosbag (mandeye-ws_noetic) into reg-1.bag by download_data.sh; ground truth HDMappingGroundTruth/all_tum_files/lio_result_0_trajectory_tum.txt. Step 4 run one algorithm at a time (all sessions at once ran out of memory on 60 GB RAM).
runs.notes: Not evaluated (no usable output): super-lio (NaN poses), ct-icp (27 s of data), loam-livox (all poses zero), slict (no poses), glim (crashed after 9 s), map-lio (crashed at start), d-lio (empty bag), fr-lio and log-lio2 (diverged), c3p-voxelmap and lio-sam (diverged by km; excluded from step 4), lio-ekf (416 GB bag, stopped), pin-slam (out of memory on CPU), nv-liom, kiss-icp, bievr-lio and glass-lio (bag-to-HDMapping converter ran out of memory; recordings kept). Truncated: sr-lio (stops at ~867 s), genz-icp (stops at ~1177 s). hdmapping-lio was stopped during the main run (its chunk cache filled the disk) and re-run on its own on 2026-11-19 with the same input and default parameters; the ground truth also comes from HDMapping (v0.105.0). Step 8 hit its 1800 s time limit for floam, form, i2ekf-lo, lidar_odometry_ros_wrapper, mola, resple, rko-lio, r-voxelmap, superOdom and voxel-map. Step 8 algorithm-to-FARO distances (~2-3 m) and Hausdorff (~100 m) are high for every algorithm, probably because the maps extend beyond the TLS scan (not yet verified); FARO-to-algorithm distance is the more reliable accuracy number.

datasets.title: KITTI odometry — sequence 07
datasets.description: KITTI odometry sequence 07 (raw drive 2011_09_30_drive_0027: Velodyne HDL-64E + OXTS RT3003 IMU at 100 Hz, about 694 m), from the kitti_to_ros ROS 1 bag, converted to the canonical bag. Trajectories are evaluated against the KITTI odometry ground-truth poses (Velodyne frame). No TLS map, so there are no point-cloud metrics.

runs.label: Canonical bag, full pipeline (steps 1-6), qt64 default configs
runs.source: start_benchmark.sh on branch KITTI-canonical, commit cffd20d; hdmapping-lio from benchmark-HDMapping_LIO-to-HDMapping c63e6b0 (HDMapping 5d43160)
runs.notes: First KITTI run on the canonical pipeline. Ground truth: KITTI odometry poses (Velodyne frame), time offset fitted to the IMU (+0.481 s after the bag's first scan; gyro z vs ground-truth yaw rate). All algorithms run with their QT64 (Oxford Spires) canonical defaults, except hdmapping-lio: HDMapping GUI preset 3 (< 30 km/h, open spaces) with skip_first_file = false (sensor_overrides.conf, hdl64); with HDMapping's default parameters it diverges on KITTI. Rings are estimated from elevation bins; point times assume the scan starts at the header stamp (KITTI stamps the forward-facing moment, so they are likely ~50 ms late); KITTI scans may already be deskewed; the canonical bag is re-sliced to 100 ms (1156 clouds vs 1111 scans). APE is aligned at the first pose (evo --align_origin). pv-lio crashed at playback start (no result). lego-loam recorded only 287 poses. voxel-map trajectory did not move (fallback alignment). LOAM-Livox skipped (needs Livox input).
